# WildBionics

> WildBionics is a bilingual (English/German) open-source compendium that explains physics, mathematics, computer science and chemistry through animals, plants, geology and bionics. Every article views one natural phenomenon through several "lenses" (physics, mathematics, computer science) and cites peer-reviewed sources with DOIs.

- Content licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 – reuse is welcome with attribution to "WildBionics ({{ site.url }})".
- Code licence: MIT. Source and issue tracker: {{ site.repository_url }}
- English lives at the site root, German under /de/. Translations share a `ref` and are linked with hreflang.
- Maintainer: {{ site.author.name }} ({{ site.author.url }})
